title: Selected Topics in the Behavioral and Social Sciences; Introduction to Data Management
description: This course serves as an introduction to computers, data management, and popular analytics software (e.g., R, Excel) and is ideal for students who have minimal training in computers and software. You will learn best practices for file management and ways read in data, clean data sets, and perform other vital functions (mainly in Excel). You will develop fundamental skills that will ease your transition into future coursework in data science or analytics.
